name: SubmitMediaComprehensionJob

parameters.help_en:
The input media. The value is a JSON string with the following structure:

Medias (Array<Object>, required): The list of media files. The array must contain 1 to 10 elements. Each element contains the following fields:
Type (String, required): The media type. Valid values: video and image. The value is not case-sensitive.
Url (String, mutually exclusive with MediaId): The URL of the media file. The URL must start with http:// or https:// and be up to 2,048 characters in length. Unregistered URLs are automatically registered as media files.
MediaId (String, mutually exclusive with Url): The ID of the registered media file. If both Url and MediaId are specified, MediaId takes precedence
parameters.help_zh:
输入素材，JSON 字符串，结构如下：

Medias（Array<Object>，必填）：媒资列表，1~10 个元素，每个元素包含
Type（String，必填）：媒资类型，取值 video 或 image（大小写不敏感）。
Url（String，与 MediaId 二选一）：媒资 URL，必须以 http:// 或 https:// 开头，长度不超过 2048 字符。未注册的 URL 会自动注册为媒资。
MediaId（String，与 Url 二选一）：已注册的媒资 ID。Url 与 MediaId 同时传入时以 MediaId 为准
parameters.name: input

parameters.help_en:
The job type. Valid values:

VideoBreakdown: Viral video breakdown. The Medias array must contain exactly one element with Type set to video.
ProductRecognition: Product image information recognition. All elements in the Medias array must have Type set to image
parameters.help_zh:
任务类型。

VideoBreakdown：爆款视频拆解，要求 Medias 恰好包含 1 个 Type=video 的元素；
ProductRecognition：产品图片信息识别，要求 Medias 中全部元素 Type=image
parameters.name: job_type

parameters.help_en:
The analysis parameters. The value is a JSON string up to 65,536 characters in length.

VideoBreakdown: Supports the ResultType parameter (String, optional). Valid value: Standard (default).
ProductRecognition: Uses parameters such as product information and prompts. The total number of fields cannot exceed 20. Example fields for product parameters include ProductName, BrandName, and SellingPoints
parameters.help_zh:
分析参数，JSON 字符串，整体长度不超过 65536 字符。

VideoBreakdown：支持 ResultType（String，选填），取值 Standard（默认）。
ProductRecognition：使用商品信息、Prompt 等参数，字段总数不超过 20 个；商品参数示例字段包括 ProductName、BrandName、SellingPoints
parameters.name: job_params

parameters.help_en: The custom parameters. The value is a JSON string. The custom parameters are returned as-is in the callback result (for example, newsKey). NotifyAddress is a system-reserved field for the callback URL. A callback is triggered after the job is completed
parameters.help_zh: 自定义参数，JSON格式字符串，回调结果原样携带（如：newsKey）。系统保留字段 NotifyAddress，回调地址URL，任务完成后回调
parameters.name: user_data

ErrorCode.description_en: The business error code. This parameter is an empty string if the job is submitted successfully
ErrorCode.description_zh: 业务错误码，提交成功时为空字符串
